lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: when a claim matters (here safety, assembly time) show it on screen in a close-up instead of only saying it. For LumeBook this means showing the page with the child's name, the paper quality and the time it takes to make the book, not only saying it is personal. A POV shot through the tunnel is a simple phone idea; the equivalent is a POV over a child's shoulder at the opened book.
